-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvConfchange` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def applyOne (cc : ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  if cc.NodeId' = W64 0 then some s
  else
    if cc.Type' = W32 0 then some (makeVoterM cc.NodeId' s)
    else
      if cc.Type' = W32 3 then some (makeLearnerM cc.NodeId' s)
      else if cc.Type' = W32 1 then some (removeM cc.NodeId' s) else if cc.Type' = W32 2 then some s else none

def CfgInv (s : CCState) : Prop :=
  (∀ (id : w64), id ∈ s.cfg.incoming ∨ id ∈ s.cfg.outgoing ∨ id ∈ s.cfg.learners ∨ id ∈ s.cfg.learnersNext → id ∈ s.prs) ∧
    (∀ (id : w64), id ∈ s.cfg.learnersNext → id ∈ s.cfg.outgoing ∧ s.prs !! id = some false) ∧
      (∀ (id : w64), id ∈ s.cfg.learners → ¬id ∈ s.cfg.outgoing ∧ ¬id ∈ s.cfg.incoming ∧ s.prs !! id = some true) ∧
        (s.cfg.outgoing = ∅ → s.cfg.learnersNext = ∅ ∧ s.cfg.autoLeave = false)

def enterJointM (autoLeave : Bool) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  if ¬CfgInv (clearAutoLeave s) then none
  else
    if s.cfg.outgoing ≠ ∅ then none
    else
      if s.cfg.incoming = ∅ then none
      else
        match
          applyM ccs
            {
              cfg :=
                have __src := s.cfg;
                { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := s.cfg.incoming, learners := __src.learners,
                  learnersNext := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := false },
              prs := s.prs } with
        | none => none
        | some s1 =>
          checkedM
            {
              cfg :=
                have __src := s1.cfg;
                { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners,
                  learnersNext := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := autoLeave },
              prs := s1.prs }

def symdiffN (l r : GSet w64) : Nat :=
  (l \ r).size + (r \ l).size

def checkedM (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  if CfgInv s then some s else none

theorem removeCfg.proj_autoLeave (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).autoLeave = c.autoLeave

theorem clearAutoLeave.proj_cfg (s : CCState) : (clearAutoLeave s).cfg = have __src := s.cfg; {
    incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners, learnersNext
    := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := false }

def flagsOf (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) : GMap w64 Bool :=
  GMap.fmap (fun pv => pv.IsLearner') pvs

def removeCfg (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : CfgM :=
  { incoming := GMap.delete id c.incoming, outgoing := c.outgoing, learners := GMap.delete id c.learners,
    learnersNext := GMap.delete id c.learnersNext, autoLeave := c.autoLeave }

theorem applyAll_snoc (l : List ConfChangeSingleM) (x : ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : applyAll
    (l ++ [x]) s = (applyAll l s).bind (applyOne x)

def initProgressM (id : w64) (isLearner : Bool) (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  {
    cfg :=
      if isLearner = true then
        have __src := s.cfg;
        { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := <[id := ()]>s.cfg.learners,
          learnersNext := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := __src.autoLeave }
      else
        have __src := s.cfg;
        { incoming := <[id := ()]>s.cfg.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners,
          learnersNext := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := __src.autoLeave },
    prs := <[id := isLearner]>s.prs }

def ownResult (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (r : Option CCState)
    (cfg : tracker.Config) (trk : Loc) (err : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  match r with
  | none => iprop(⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝)
  | some s => iprop(⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) s.cfg ∗ ownPrsW chg base trk s.prs)

def removeM (id : w64) (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  if id ∈ s.prs then { cfg := removeCfg id s.cfg, prs := if id ∈ s.cfg.outgoing then s.prs else GMap.delete id s.prs }
  else s

theorem ownNewPr_copies [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (pvs : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) : ⊢ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg pvs k pv

theorem ownPrs_borrow [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (id : w64) (pr : Loc)
    (pv : tracker.Progress) (hpr : prs !! id = some pr) (hpv : pvs !! id = some pv) : (([∗map] pr;pv
    ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k pv) ⊢
    typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ∀ b, typedPointsto pr { Match' := pv.Match', Next' :=
    pv.Next', sentCommit' := pv.sentCommit', State' := pv.State', PendingSnapshot' :=
    pv.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' := pv.RecentActive', MsgAppFlowPaused' :=
    pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv.Inflights', IsLearner' := b } (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ([∗map]
    pr;pv ∈ prs;<[id :=
                { Match' := pv.Match', Next' := pv.Next', sentCommit' := pv.sentCommit', State' := pv.State',
                  PendingSnapshot' := pv.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' := pv.RecentActive',
                  MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv.Inflights', IsLearner' := b }]>pvs,
              typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
            [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈
              <[id :=
                { Match' := pv.Match', Next' := pv.Next', sentCommit' := pv.sentCommit', State' := pv.State',
                  PendingSnapshot' := pv.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' := pv.RecentActive',
                  MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv.Inflights', IsLearner' := b }]>pvs,
              ownNewPr chg base k pv

def ownNewPr (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (id : w64) (pv :
    tracker.Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜∃ pv0,
          base !! id = some pv0 ∧
            pv =
              { Match' := pv0.Match', Next' := pv0.Next', sentCommit' := pv0.sentCommit', State' := pv0.State',
                PendingSnapshot' := pv0.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' := pv0.RecentActive',
                MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv0.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv0.Inflights', IsLearner' := pv.IsLearner' }⌝ ∨
      ⌜FreshPr chg pv⌝ ∗
        ownInflights pv.Inflights' (inflightsNew chg.Tracker'.MaxInflight' chg.Tracker'.MaxInflightBytes'))

theorem ownWork_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (cfgp trk : Loc) (s : CCState) (cfg : tracker.Config) (prs : GMap w64 Loc)
    (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (Hflags : flagsOf pvs = s.prs) : ⊢ typedPointsto cfgp cfg
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) s.cfg -∗ ownMap trk (DFrac.own 1) prs -∗ ([∗map]
    pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k
    pv) -∗ ownWork chg base cfgp trk s

def ownCfgAt (cfgp : Loc) (c : CfgM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ cfg, typedPointsto cfgp cfg (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) c)

theorem ownNewPr_set_learner [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (id : w64) (pv : tracker.Progress) (b : Bool) : ownNewPr chg base id pv ⊢
    ownNewPr chg base id { Match' := pv.Match', Next' := pv.Next', sentCommit' := pv.sentCommit',
    State' := pv.State', PendingSnapshot' := pv.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' := pv.RecentActive',
    MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv.Inflights', IsLearner' := b }

theorem ownCfgCC_elim [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (dq : DFrac) (c : CfgM) :
    ownCfgCC cfg dq c ⊢ ∃ vin vout, ⌜cfg.Voters'.arr = [vin, vout]⌝ ∗ ownMap vin dq c.incoming ∗
    ownIdsetC vout dq c.outgoing ∗ ownIdsetC cfg.Learners' dq c.learners ∗ ownIdsetC
    cfg.LearnersNext' dq c.learnersNext ∗ ⌜cfg.AutoLeave' = c.autoLeave⌝

def applyAll : List ConfChangeSingleM → CCState → Option CCState :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => CCState → Option CCState) x✝¹ applyAll._f x✝

theorem leaveJointState.proj_cfg (s : CCState) : (leaveJointState s).cfg = { incoming :=
    s.cfg.incoming, outgoing := ∅, learners := s.cfg.learners ∪ s.cfg.learnersNext, learnersNext :=
    ∅, autoLeave := false }

theorem flagsOf_insert (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (k : w64) (pv : tracker.Progress) : flagsOf
    <[k := pv]>pvs = <[k := pv.IsLearner']>(flagsOf pvs)

def applyM (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  (applyAll ccs s).bind fun s' => if s'.cfg.incoming = ∅ then none else some s'

theorem mem_of_domSet_eq {V V' : Type} {a : GMap w64 V} {b : GMap w64 V'} (h : a.domSet = b.domSet)
    (k : w64) : k ∈ a ↔ k ∈ b

theorem flagsOf_lookup (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (k : w64) (pv : tracker.Progress) (h : pvs
    !! k = some pv) : flagsOf pvs !! k = some pv.IsLearner'

theorem ownWork_elim [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (cfgp trk : Loc) (s : CCState) : ownWork chg base cfgp trk s ⊢ ∃ cfg prs pvs,
    typedPointsto cfgp cfg (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ownCfgCC cfg (DFrac.own 1) s.cfg ∗ ownMap trk (DFrac.own
    1) prs ∗ ([∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗ ⌜flagsOf pvs = s.prs⌝ ∗
    [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k pv

def SymdiffTooBig (l r : GSet w64) : Prop :=
  1 < sint.Z (W64 ↑(symdiffN l r))

theorem clearAutoLeave.proj_prs (s : CCState) : (clearAutoLeave s).prs = s.prs

theorem flagsOf_mem (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (k : w64) : k ∈ flagsOf pvs ↔ (pvs !!
    k).isSome = true

theorem flagsOf_delete (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (k : w64) : flagsOf (GMap.delete k pvs) =
    GMap.delete k (flagsOf pvs)

theorem ownPrs_delete [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (id : w64) : (([∗map]
    pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k
    pv) ⊢ ([∗map] pr;pv ∈ GMap.delete id prs;GMap.delete id pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1))
    ∗ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ GMap.delete id pvs, ownNewPr chg base k pv

def ownPrsW (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (trk : Loc) (p : GMap w64
    Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ prs pvs,
      "Htrk" ∷ ownMap trk (DFrac.own 1) prs ∗
        ("Hprs" ∷ [∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1)) ∗
          "%Hflags" ∷ ⌜flagsOf pvs = p⌝ ∗ "Hnew" ∷ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k pv)

theorem leaveJointState.proj_prs (s : CCState) : (leaveJointState s).prs = GMap.filter (fun k x =>
    decide (k ∈ s.cfg.incoming ∨ k ∈ s.cfg.learners ∪ s.cfg.learnersNext ∨ ¬k ∈ s.cfg.outgoing))
    (GMap.fmap (fun x => true) (GMap.filter (fun k x => decide (k ∈ s.cfg.learnersNext)) s.prs) ∪
    s.prs)

def makeVoterM (id : w64) (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  if id ∈ s.prs then
    {
      cfg :=
        have __src := s.cfg;
        { incoming := <[id := ()]>s.cfg.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := GMap.delete id s.cfg.learners,
          learnersNext := GMap.delete id s.cfg.learnersNext, autoLeave := __src.autoLeave },
      prs := <[id := false]>s.prs }
  else initProgressM id false s

theorem ownNewPr_elim [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (k : w64) (pv : tracker.Progress) : ownNewPr chg base k pv ⊢ ⌜∃ pv0, base !! k
    = some pv0 ∧ pv = { Match' := pv0.Match', Next' := pv0.Next', sentCommit' := pv0.sentCommit',
    State' := pv0.State', PendingSnapshot' := pv0.PendingSnapshot', RecentActive' :=
    pv0.RecentActive', MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv0.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' := pv0.Inflights',
    IsLearner' := pv.IsLearner' }⌝ ∨ ⌜FreshPr chg pv⌝ ∗ ownInflights pv.Inflights' (inflightsNew
    chg.Tracker'.MaxInflight' chg.Tracker'.MaxInflightBytes')

theorem removeCfg.proj_incoming (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).incoming = GMap.delete id
    c.incoming

theorem ownCfgCC_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : tracker.Config) (dq : DFrac) (c : CfgM)
    (vin vout : Loc) (Harr : cfg.Voters'.arr = [vin, vout]) (Hal : cfg.AutoLeave' = c.autoLeave) : ⊢
    ownMap vin dq c.incoming -∗ ownIdsetC vout dq c.outgoing -∗ ownIdsetC cfg.Learners' dq
    c.learners -∗ ownIdsetC cfg.LearnersNext' dq c.learnersNext -∗ ownCfgCC cfg dq c

theorem initProgressM.proj_prs (id : w64) (isLearner : Bool) (s : CCState) : (initProgressM id
    isLearner s).prs = <[id := isLearner]>s.prs

theorem checkedM_some {s s' : CCState} (h : checkedM s = some s') : s' = s ∧ CfgInv s

def ownCfgCC (cfg : tracker.Config) (dq : DFrac) (c : CfgM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ vin vout,
      "%Harr" ∷ ⌜cfg.Voters'.arr = [vin, vout]⌝ ∗
        "Hin" ∷ ownMap vin dq c.incoming ∗
          "Hout" ∷ ownIdsetC vout dq c.outgoing ∗
            "Hl" ∷ ownIdsetC cfg.Learners' dq c.learners ∗
              "Hln" ∷ ownIdsetC cfg.LearnersNext' dq c.learnersNext ∗ "%Hal" ∷ ⌜cfg.AutoLeave' = c.autoLeave⌝)

def addNodeCC (id : w64) : ConfChangeSingleM :=
  { Type' := W32 0, NodeId' := id }

theorem ownNewPr_transfer [package_sem : Assumptions] (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) (R Q : w64 → tracker.Progress → IProp GF) (Hcopy : ∀ (k : w64) (pv0 pv :
    tracker.Progress), base !! k = some pv0 → pv = { Match' := pv0.Match', Next' := pv0.Next',
    sentCommit' := pv0.sentCommit', State' := pv0.State', PendingSnapshot' := pv0.PendingSnapshot',
    RecentActive' := pv0.RecentActive', MsgAppFlowPaused' := pv0.MsgAppFlowPaused', Inflights' :=
    pv0.Inflights', IsLearner' := pv.IsLearner' } → R k pv0 ⊢ Q k pv) (Hfresh : ∀ (k : w64) (pv :
    tracker.Progress), FreshPr chg pv → ownInflights pv.Inflights' (inflightsNew
    chg.Tracker'.MaxInflight' chg.Tracker'.MaxInflightBytes') ⊢ Q k pv) (pvs : GMap w64
    tracker.Progress) : (([∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ base, R k pv) ∗ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, ownNewPr chg base k
    pv) ⊢ [∗map] k ↦ pv ∈ pvs, Q k pv

theorem removeCfg.proj_learners (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).learners = GMap.delete id
    c.learners

def leaveJointM (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  if ¬CfgInv (clearAutoLeave s) then none else if s.cfg.outgoing = ∅ then none else checkedM (leaveJointState s)

theorem flagsOf_lookup' (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (k : w64) : flagsOf pvs !! k = Option.map
    (fun pv => pv.IsLearner') (pvs !! k)

def opSpec (f : GoFunc) (chg : confchange.Changer) (P Q : tracker.Config → Loc → IProp GF) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∀ cfg prs,
      □
        ∀ Φ,
          P cfg prs -∗
            (▷ ∀ cfg' prs', Q cfg' prs' -∗ Φ ((intoVal cfg', intoVal prs'), intoVal GoInterface.nil)) -∗
              WP
                ((intoVal f)
                  (intoVal
                    {
                      Tracker' :=
                        have __src := chg.Tracker';
                        { Config' := cfg, Progress' := prs, Votes' := __src.Votes', MaxInflight' := __src.MaxInflight',
                          MaxInflightBytes' := __src.MaxInflightBytes' },
                      LastIndex' := chg.LastIndex' }))
                {{ Φ }})

theorem removeCfg.proj_learnersNext (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).learnersNext =
    GMap.delete id c.learnersNext

theorem removeCfg.proj_outgoing (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).outgoing = c.outgoing

def simpleM (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : Option CCState :=
  if ¬CfgInv (clearAutoLeave s) then none
  else
    if s.cfg.outgoing ≠ ∅ then none
    else
      match applyM ccs (clearAutoLeave s) with
      | none => none
      | some s1 => if SymdiffTooBig s.cfg.incoming s1.cfg.incoming then none else checkedM s1

theorem initProgressM.proj_cfg (id : w64) (isLearner : Bool) (s : CCState) : (initProgressM id
    isLearner s).cfg = if isLearner = true then have __src := s.cfg; { incoming := __src.incoming,
    outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := <[id := ()]>s.cfg.learners, learnersNext :=
    __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := __src.autoLeave } else have __src := s.cfg; { incoming := <[id
    := ()]>s.cfg.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners, learnersNext :=
    __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := __src.autoLeave }

def makeLearnerM (id : w64) (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  match s.prs !! id with
  | none => initProgressM id true s
  | some true => s
  | some false =>
    if id ∈ s.cfg.outgoing then
      {
        cfg :=
          have __src := removeCfg id s.cfg;
          { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners,
            learnersNext := <[id := ()]>(GMap.delete id s.cfg.learnersNext), autoLeave := __src.autoLeave },
        prs := s.prs }
    else
      {
        cfg :=
          have __src := removeCfg id s.cfg;
          { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing,
            learners := <[id := ()]>(GMap.delete id s.cfg.learners), learnersNext := __src.learnersNext,
            autoLeave := __src.autoLeave },
        prs := <[id := true]>s.prs }

theorem applyAll_append (l1 l2 : List ConfChangeSingleM) (s : CCState) : applyAll (l1 ++ l2) s =
    (applyAll l1 s).bind (applyAll l2)

theorem applyAll.eq_def (x✝ : List ConfChangeSingleM) (x✝¹ : CCState) : applyAll x✝ x✝¹ = match x✝,
    x✝¹ with | [], s => some s | cc :: ccs, s => (applyOne cc s).bind (applyAll ccs)

def ownWork (chg : confchange.Changer) (base : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) (cfgp trk : Loc) (s :
    CCState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownCfgAt cfgp s.cfg ∗ ownPrsW chg base trk s.prs)

def FreshPr (chg : confchange.Changer) (pv : tracker.Progress) : Prop :=
  pv.Match' = W64 0 ∧
    uint.Z pv.Next' = max (uint.Z chg.LastIndex') 1 ∧
      pv.sentCommit' = W64 0 ∧
        pv.State' = W64 0 ∧ pv.PendingSnapshot' = W64 0 ∧ pv.RecentActive' = true ∧ pv.MsgAppFlowPaused' = false

def clearAutoLeave (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  {
    cfg :=
      have __src := s.cfg;
      { incoming := __src.incoming, outgoing := __src.outgoing, learners := __src.learners,
        learnersNext := __src.learnersNext, autoLeave := false },
    prs := s.prs }

def addLearnerCC (id : w64) : ConfChangeSingleM :=
  { Type' := W32 3, NodeId' := id }

def ownTrackerCC (tv : tracker.ProgressTracker) (dqc dqm dqp : DFrac) (c : CfgM) (prs : GMap w64
    Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 tracker.Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ownCfgCC tv.Config' dqc c ∗ ownMap tv.Progress' dqm prs ∗ [∗map] pr;pv ∈ prs;pvs, typedPointsto pr pv dqp)

structure CCState : Type where
  cfg : CfgM
  prs : GMap w64 Bool

def leaveJointState (s : CCState) : CCState :=
  {
    cfg :=
      { incoming := s.cfg.incoming, outgoing := ∅, learners := s.cfg.learners ∪ s.cfg.learnersNext, learnersNext := ∅,
        autoLeave := false },
    prs :=
      GMap.filter (fun k x => decide (k ∈ s.cfg.incoming ∨ k ∈ s.cfg.learners ∪ s.cfg.learnersNext ∨ ¬k ∈ s.cfg.outgoing))
        (GMap.fmap (fun x => true) (GMap.filter (fun k x => decide (k ∈ s.cfg.learnersNext)) s.prs) ∪ s.prs) }
